items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: No, just Head. You played by Head you didn't? No, no music, no.

ctx.x: And what about uh... Well, Pete Boccage used to play some of those funny little instruments. No, violin. The only violin when you do it? That's all I know. What kind of music did you play on the violin? What type of music?

The classic music. Pete, like when Pete taught... Not what about the mandolin? Oh, we'd play anything. Yeah. I could play a selection of Scotch, uh... French... Yeah. And uh... German music. I could... I'd play any kind of number like that, but I know, you know, they like the people... We playing for... I was good on it, yeah. Do you remember any of the names of any of these numbers? No, just Head. You played by Head you didn't? No, no music, no.
What about cakewalks? Did you ever play any cakewalks? I played quadrille, cakewalks.
